Name: Joja Sprinklers
Author: Bluejal
Description:
This mod makes the three tiers of sprinklers available to buy at JojaMart in Stardew Valley 1.6.

You will need to have [b]Content Patcher[/b] installed in your mods folder for this to work. If you don't have it yet, you can download it [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]from here[/url].
[b]SMAPI[/b] is also required, which can be downloaded [url=https://smapi.io/]here[/url].

This mod is compatible with and can be run alongside [i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21206]Pierre Sprinklers[/url][/i] if you wish, which allows you to buy sprinklers from Pierre's shop. Having both means you can buy them from either shop.

If you encounter any issues or have any feedback please do let me know.
